About DataSkip | Skip Tracing and Property Data from Arizona, USA DataSkip .io Pricing Industries Developers FAQ Contact Us Sign In Sign Up Company About DataSkip DataSkip is a skip tracing and property data service based in Arizona, USA. We turn a US property address into the owner's name, phone numbers with Do Not Call flags, email addresses, and mailing address, so that teams whose work starts from a property can reach the person who owns it. Our customers are real estate investors and wholesalers, roofing, solar, and home service companies, property managers, and collections teams. What we do Upload a list of property addresses as Excel or CSV (up to 250,000 records in a single run) and get a clean CSV back with the owner contact data attached to every matched row. Developers get the same skip tracing through a REST API, a command line tool, and a typed JavaScript/TypeScript SDK, published as the official npm package skiptrace . Teams that do not have a list yet can buy property owner data by the record and skip trace it in the same platform.
